messages:
sophie: Quick sync — can we standardize the internal incident communication templates? I pushed a draft below. Need compact status page copy, a customer-facing email, and an internal handoff snippet for on-call. @maria @alex @jamal PTAL :eyes:

incident-bot: Pager triggered: SEV2 — increased 99th pct latency (api-prod, eu-west-1). On-call: jamal. Incident thread created: https://redwood.incidents/INC-20260317-47

jamal: On it. I'll triage then hand off to lead-sre if needed. Sophie, do you want the templates to live in the incidents repo or a google doc?

sophie: Prefer incidents repo (MD in /comm-templates). Keep editable snippets we can copy into status page and emails.

maria: Quick note on tone: customers prefer concise + what we know/what we're doing/ETA. Avoid overly technical noise unless it's a tech customer. Internal messages should be more detailed.

alex: Agreed. Also include placeholders for affected regions, percentage of customers, and recommended customer workarounds.

sophie: Drafts below. Feel free to copy/paste. We should standardize sections: summary, impact, scope, mitigation, ETA, workarounds, contact, incident_id, timeline.

sophie: STATUS PAGE SHORT (for status.redwood.com):
```
[Incident {{incident_id}}] Partial degradation of text generation in eu-west-1. We're seeing increased latencies for a subset of requests. Our engineers are investigating; mitigation in progress. Updates at ~30m intervals or sooner.```

sophie: STATUS PAGE LONG (for detailed updates):
```
Summary: Partial service degradation affecting text generation in eu-west-1.
Impact: Increased request latency and intermittent timeouts for ~X% of requests
Scope: Customers using model X and routed to eu-west-1.
Mitigation: Autoscaling + rolling restart of inference pool underway. Temporary routing to eu-central is enabled for high priority customers.
ETA: Initial mitigation complete in 45–60 minutes; full recovery TBD.
Action for customers: No immediate action required. If you need lower latency, request temporary routing via support@redwood.com.
Next update: in 30 minutes or when we have new info.
```

sophie: CUSTOMER EMAIL TEMPLATE (brief):
```
Subject: [Redwood] Incident {{incident_id}} — Impact to text generation in eu-west-1
Hi {{customer_name}},
We’re investigating an issue causing increased latency for text generation in eu-west-1 which may affect some requests. Our engineers are actively mitigating and we've enabled temporary routing for high-priority customers.
What we're doing now: autoscale and targeted restarts to reduce latency.
When we’ll update: within ~30 minutes or sooner.
If you’re impacted and need immediate assistance please reply or open a support ticket ({{support_link}}).
Apologies for the disruption — we’ll keep you posted.
— Redwood Support
```

sophie: INTERNAL HANDOFF SNIPPET (Slack on-call -> next on-call):
```
Handoff: INC-{{incident_id}}
Current status: Mitigation in progress (autoscale + restart). Partial recovery observed.
Key metrics: 99th latency up from 250ms -> 1.8s, error rate +0.7%.
Actions taken: scaled + restarted inference pool; enabled routing to eu-central for premium customers.
Open tasks: follow-up metric checks, validate rollback plan, confirm status page update.
Next steps / owner: jamal -> monitor for 30m, then handoff to lead-sre if no improvement.
Contact: @jamal, sos-pager
```

sophie: TONE GUIDELINES (short bullets):
- Be concise and factual.
- Lead with impact and customer-facing facts.
- Avoid hyperbole; state what we know vs unknown.
- Provide clear next steps and who to contact.

alex: Can we add a tiny template for escalation emails to account teams? They like a 1-line summary + impact + ask.

maria: Yes — ACCOUNT ESCALATION SNIPPET:
```
Subject: Urgent — Incident {{incident_id}} affecting {{customer_segment}}
One-liner: Partial degradation of text generation in eu-west-1 impacting {{percent}} of requests.
Impact: Latency and occasional timeouts; priority customers may experience degraded UX.
Ask: Please notify your reps and offer churn-risk customers immediate routing; contact ops@redwood for route changes.
```

jamal: This is great. I'll copy these into /incidents/comm-templates.md and add a checklist for status page cadence (initial, 30m, 1h, update on resolution).

lead-sre: Add a line about regulatory customers — they must get hands-on notice before public status if data residency involved.

sophie: Good call. Add placeholder: {{regulatory_flag}}.

maria: LGTM. I'll run a quick pass to remove jargony bits and make customer copy more empathetic.

jamal: Wrapping up triage now. Will post incident metrics in the thread and update status page.

incident-bot: Incident INC-20260317-47 status update: mitigation partial, next update scheduled at 1763433900.

sophie: Thanks everyone. Once jamal confirms recovery let's standardize the post-incident note template too (timeline + customer impact + RCA pointer).

jamal: Will do. Leaving notes here when done.
